quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What happens when you take drugs with alcohol?

options.text: It increases the risk of a crash.
It is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
It reduces the effect of alcohol on your driving.
It has no effect on your driving ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: It increases the risk of a crash.
questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter) affect your brain and impair your driving. Mixing drugs with alcohol greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction.
During daylight hours only.
At any time.
When making turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: When making turns.
questions.explanation: You can cross broken lines but not solid lines. The only exception is when you are turning.

questions.question: How do you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Avoid sudden stops.
Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal and let your car slow before braking.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Sudden stops are dangerous. Release the gas pedal first to slow down, then apply steady brake pressure. Check mirrors and blind spots before stopping so drivers behind you can see your brake lights and react.

questions.question: What should you do when a car has bright headlights pointed at you?

options.text: Use your bright lights until they dim theirs.
Flash your lights to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and speed up to pass quickly.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look away from the bright headlights and toward the right side of the road until the car passes. This protects your vision and keeps you safe.

questions.question: What should you do while backing up?

options.text: Rely only on your mirrors.
Flash your lights.
Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to see through the rear window. Do not rely only on mirrors.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only behind your vehicle.
Only on the left and right sides.
Only in front.
On all sides.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not drive too close to other vehicles.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
The traffic signal is broken.
You do not have to come to a complete stop.
Driving conditions are dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light is the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, look for traffic and pedestrians, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you use?

options.text: The lane closest to your previous lane.
The lane marked with an arrow.
The middle lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Divided highway ends.
Two-way traffic.
Keep left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending soon. Be prepared for oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does a good defensive driver do?

options.text: Drives slowly at all times.
Watches what other drivers do.
Travels at a constant speed.
Only drives in familiar areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: A defensive driver watches other drivers and expects problems. This helps you react quickly to hazards on the road.

questions.question: Leaving space between your vehicle and other vehicles is important because it:

options.text: Stops other vehicles from distracting you.
Gives you time to react to sudden problems.
Keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.
Keeps other drivers alert.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to react to sudden problems.
questions.explanation: Leave plenty of space between your vehicle and others. This gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: Downward-pointing triangular signs tell drivers to:

options.text: Watch for schools.
Yield and let others go first.
Watch for construction.
Watch for railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield and let others go first.
questions.explanation: Downward-pointing triangular signs mean yield. Wait until the road is clear of traffic and pedestrians, then you may go.

questions.question: If someone is injured in an accident, you should:

options.text: Move them away from the scene right away.
Always leave them where they are.
Don't move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Don't move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move an injured person unless you must. Moving them the wrong way can make injuries worse. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is heavy bleeding, use direct pressure to slow it.

questions.question: Young children riding in a vehicle should:

options.text: Be held by a strong adult.
Stand on the floor in the back.
Be fine in a crash because they are small.
Never stand while the vehicle is moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never stand while the vehicle is moving.
questions.explanation: Children need special car seats. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during a crash or sudden stop. Always use a proper seat for your child.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic coming from both directions.
Lanes are shifting.
Low overhead clearance.
A new lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic coming from both directions.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: Orange signs are used for:

options.text: Work zones on the road.
Rules of the road.
School zones.
Directions and information.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zones on the road.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn you that workers are on or near the highway. These signs have black letters or symbols.

questions.question: When a driver behind you is passing, you should:

options.text: Speed up.
Keep going the same speed.
Slow down to give them room to pass safely.
Change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give them room to pass safely.
questions.explanation: Slow down when someone is passing you. This gives them enough space to pass safely and quickly.

questions.question: When a green light appears, you should:

options.text: Let pedestrians cross first.
Speed up as fast as you can.
Back up slowly.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, let any traffic and pedestrians still in the intersection pass.

questions.question: Many crashes happen because:

options.text: Drivers go too fast for road conditions.
Drivers always check mirrors and blind spots.
Drivers let others go first.
Drivers keep a safe distance behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers go too fast for road conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers go too fast. Always follow the speed limit and slow down when conditions are bad.

questions.question: If you cause a crash and don't pay for damages, your:

options.text: License and/or plates will be suspended for one year.
You will save money.
Car will be taken away.
You must buy a new car.

questions.correctAnswerText: License and/or plates will be suspended for one year.
questions.explanation: If you cause a crash and don't pay damages, your license and/or plates will be suspended for one year. You can get them back early if you pay a fee and prove you settled the damages.

questions.question: You see an oncoming car on your left and a bicyclist on your right. What should you do?

options.text: Pull onto the shoulder.
Split the difference.
Let the car pass and then pass the bike.
Pass the bike quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass and then pass the bike.
questions.explanation: When you face multiple hazards, handle one at a time. Don't try to pass the bike and avoid the car at the same time. Wait for the oncoming car to pass first. Then pass the bicyclist.

questions.question: Two solid white lines mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Motor vehicles have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks.
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of all traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show pedestrians where to safely cross. You must always stop for pedestrians who are in a crosswalk.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Continue normally through the intersection.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means "caution." Slow down, look around, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What shape is a stop sign?

options.text: Rectangle.
Square.
Circle.
Octagon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Octagon.
questions.explanation: Only stop signs have an octagon (eight-sided) shape. All eight-sided signs mean you must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, what must you do?

options.text: Drive slowly to give approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to move.
Honk your horn so vehicles and pedestrians know to get out of your way.
Stop and only proceed when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
Ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and only proceed when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the roadway from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians crossing. Stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failure to stop is illegal.
